endpoint.stored_coordinates: optimizer (z_c, z_w) with reduced tail-constrained coefficients

scale_check.criterion: bitwise equality of the column norms D (judged)

gram_check.criterion: judged (lead 15:52:20Z item 1): ||R^T R - Js^T Js||_F / ||R^T R||_F <= 1e-12, where R is the stored Householder QR factor of the scaled Jacobian J[:, perm]/D and Js the scaled EVAL J_cw; justification: both sides are float64 evaluations of the same Gram matrix of unit-norm columns (433009-term inner products, Householder QR), whose rounding is of order 1e-15 to 1e-14 relative, so a difference above 1e-12 would show a different Jacobian; a Gram equality is not a matrix equality (Q is not retained): the record-summary comparison below is the bitwise check

comparison_with_stored_final_record.record_summary_criterion: judged: every saved summary field (R, Q^T r, D, perm, z_opt, generator) of the EVAL record equals the stored record bitwise; this establishes equality of the saved QR summaries, not of the full Jacobian (Q is not retained)

info.construction: J_c = J_cw + target correction (all columns, through to_full) + V(c_l, omega) five-point columns x chain factors on the closure block

J_c.scaling: columns divided by their norms (no gauge projection yet)
